title: Nola band becomes the Silver Top band under old man Dutrey; pianists
summary: Old man Dutrey took over and renamed it; he played clarinet and sax, the band added piano, usually a woman pianist.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

His daddy.

That was the band, Sam Banner. They said, he took the band over. He just changed the name.
I see.
From the Nola to the Silverton.
